headline.zh: 为 AI 代理提供授权数据
headline.en: Supply Licensed Data to AI Agents

scenario.zh: 开发者通过 API 为 AI 代理获取科学、医疗或法律领域的高质量授权数据
scenario.en: Developer uses API to fetch licensed high-quality data in scientific, medical, or legal domains for AI agents

instruction.zh: 选择 AI 代理需要查询的专业领域
instruction.en: Choose the domain your AI agent needs to query

output.zh: 获取发表论文和研究数据
output.en: Retrieve published papers and research data

input.zh: 查询关键词：CRISPR 基因编辑应用
input.en: Query keywords: CRISPR gene editing applications

output.en: Title: Efficient base editor design | Author team: Zhang Lab | Published: 2024 | Key finding: Novel approach improves editing precision

output.zh: 获取临床指南和治疗方案
output.en: Retrieve clinical guidelines and treatment protocols

input.zh: 查询关键词：2 型糖尿病管理

output.zh: 指南来源：国际糖尿病协会 | 更新时间：2024 年 | 治疗路径：初始单药，条件下联合用药 | 监测指标：血糖控制达标情况
output.en: Guideline source: International Diabetes Association | Updated: 2024 | Treatment path: Initial monotherapy, combination therapy when indicated | Monitoring: Glycemic control targets
Retrieve case law and statute interpretations

input.zh: 查询关键词：数据隐私跨境传输

output.en: Case reference: EU 2024 ruling | Topic: Personal data flow regulation | Ruling point: Lawful transfer requires specific protection conditions | Scope: EU member states and affiliated regions
